verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official CLI for working with an Airwallex account directly from the command line, and a probe confirmed the first-party CLI docs page exists. The evidence is only a single summary line, so command coverage and depth are unproven. Missing for 10: details on command coverage across APIs, agent-friendly features such as structured/JSON output or non-interactive auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
